result = []

articles = []

    articles.append(item)

articles.sort(
    key=lambda item: item["json"].get("date", ""),
    reverse=True
)

keywords = {
    # High-value events
    "launch": 3,
    "release": 3,
    "released": 3,
    "unveil": 3,
    "announce": 2,

    "acquisition": 4,
    "acquire": 4,
    "merger": 4,
    "funding": 3,
    "raises": 3,

    "billion": 3,
    "million": 1,

    # Companies
    "openai": 4,
    "anthropic": 4,
    "google": 2,
    "nvidia": 4,
    "microsoft": 2,
    "meta": 2,
    "amazon": 2,
    "apple": 2,
    "deepmind": 3,
    "huggingface": 2,

    # Topics
    "gpu": 3,
    "chip": 3,
    "semiconductor": 3,
    "model": 2,
    "llm": 3,
    "data center": 3,
    "datacenter": 3,
    "robot": 2,
    "research": 2,
    "breakthrough": 3,
    "layoff": 3,
    "ipo": 3,

    # Negative signals
    "sponsored": -5,
    "advertisement": -5,
    "webinar": -3,
    "opinion": -2
}


result = []

for item in _items:

    article = item["json"]

    title = article.get("title", "").lower()

    score = 0

    for keyword, weight in keywords.items():

        if keyword in title:
            score += weight

    article["score"] = score

    if score > 0:
        result.append(item)


result.sort(
    key=lambda item: item["json"]["score"],
    reverse=True
)


return result

seen = set()
result = []

for item in _items:

    title = item["json"].get("title", "").lower().strip()

    if title not in seen:
        seen.add(title)
        result.append(item)

return result[:100]
